article.headline: Keishon Porter, Po’Boigh King lead North Carolina Central over Maryland Eastern Shore 88-69
article.description: — Keishon Porter and Po’Boigh King both scored 23 in North Carolina Central's 88-69 win over Maryland Eastern Shore on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Keishon Porter, Po’Boigh King lead North Carolina Central over Maryland Eastern Shore 88-69

categories.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ North Carolina Central Eagles

event.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ North Carolina Central Eagles

keywords: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ North Carolina Central Eagles
article.story: DURHAM, N.C. -- — Keishon Porter and Po’Boigh King both scored 23 in North Carolina Central's 88-69 win over Maryland Eastern Shore on Saturday night. Porter also had five rebounds for the Eagles (8-12, 1-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). King made three 3-pointers. Isaac Parson added 13 points. Ketron Shaw and Kyrell Shaw both scored 15 to lead the Hawks (4-14, 0-2). Shaw added four assists. Cardell Bailey scored 12. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
